The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM parser for CrowdStrike Falcon
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled:bool = false, pack:bool = false) {
    CrowdStrike_Auth_Events_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | extend EventName = coalesce(event_simpleName, tostring(split(name, "V")[0]))
    | where EventName in~ ("UserLogon", "UserLogonMac", "UserLogonLin", "UserLogoff", "UserLogoffMac", "UserLogoffLin", "UserLogonFailed", "UserLogonFailed2", "UserLogonFailed2Mac", "UserLogonFailed2Lin", "IoSessionLoggedOn")
    | extend SourceFields = iff(pack, pack_all(), dynamic({}))
    | extend
        EventType = iff(EventName startswith "UserLogoff", "Logoff", "Logon"),
        EventResult = iff(EventName startswith "UserLogonFailed", "Failure", "Success"),
        EventOriginalType = EventName,
        EventOriginalSubType = LogonType,
        EventOriginalResultDetails = strcat(Status, iff(isnotempty(SubStatus), strcat("/", SubStatus), "")),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(
            unixtime_seconds_todatetime(ContextTimeStamp),
            unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(timestamp),
            unixtime_seconds_todatetime(iff(EventName startswith "UserLogoff", LogoffTime, LogonTime)),
            TimeGenerated),
        DvcIpAddr = coalesce(tostring(AdditionalFields.LocalAddressIP4), tostring(AdditionalFields.LocalAddressIP6), aip),
        ComputerName = tostring(AdditionalFields.ComputerName),
        SrcIpAddr = coalesce(RemoteAddressIP4, RemoteAddressIP6),
        TargetUsername = coalesce(UserPrincipal, UserCanonical, iff(isnotempty(LogonDomain) and isnotempty(UserName) and UserName !contains "\\" and UserName !contains "@", strcat(LogonDomain, "\\", UserName), UserName)),
        TargetUserId = coalesce(UserSid, UID),
        TargetUserIdType = case(isnotempty(UserSid), "SID", isnotempty(UID), "UID", ""),
        TargetUserType = case(UserIsAdmin == "1", "Admin", UserIsAdmin == "0", "Regular", ""),
        TargetSessionId = coalesce(AuthenticationUuidAsString, AuthenticationUuid, AuthenticationId, AuthenticationIdMac, LogonId, LoginSessionId, SessionId),
        DvcOs = case(event_platform =~ "Win", "Windows", event_platform =~ "Mac", "macOS", event_platform =~ "Lin", "Linux", event_platform)
    | extend
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        EventSubType = case(LogonType == "0", "System", LogonType in ("2", "7", "11"), "Interactive", LogonType == "3", "Remote", LogonType == "5", "Service", LogonType == "8", "NetworkCleartext", LogonType == "10", "RemoteInteractive", ""),
        EventResultDetails = iff(EventResult == "Failure", "Other", ""),
        TargetUsernameType = case(TargetUsername contains "@", "UPN", TargetUsername contains "\\", "Windows", isnotempty(TargetUsername), "Simple", ""),
        DvcHostname = iff(tostring(split(ComputerName, ".")[0]) matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$", tostring(split(ComputerName, ".")[0]), ""),
        DvcDomain = iff(ComputerName contains ".", substring(ComputerName, indexof(ComputerName, ".") + 1), ""),
        DvcFQDN = iff(ComputerName contains ".", ComputerName, ""),
        SrcHostname = iff(tostring(split(ClientComputerName, ".")[0]) matches regex @"^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,61}$", tostring(split(ClientComputerName, ".")[0]), ""),
        SrcDomain = iff(ClientComputerName contains ".", substring(ClientComputerName, indexof(ClientComputerName, ".") + 1), ""),
        SrcFQDN = iff(ClientComputerName contains ".", ClientComputerName, "")
    | project-rename
        DvcId = aid,
        DvcScopeId = cid,
        TargetUserSid = UserSid,
        TargetUserUid = UID,
        TargetUserUpn = UserPrincipal,
        TargetUserScope = LogonDomain,
        TargetOriginalUserType = UserIsAdmin,
        LogonProtocol = AuthenticationPackage
    | extend
        Dvc = coalesce(DvcFQDN, DvcHostname, DvcId, DvcIpAddr, ComputerName),
        DvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        DvcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(DvcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
        SrcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(SrcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
        Src = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, SrcFQDN, SrcHostname),
        TargetHostname = DvcHostname,
        TargetDomain = DvcDomain,
        TargetDomainType = iff(isnotempty(DvcDomain), "FQDN", ""),
        TargetFQDN = DvcFQDN,
        TargetDvcId = DvcId,
        TargetDvcIdType = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        TargetIpAddr = DvcIpAddr,
        TargetDvcOs = DvcOs,
        TargetDvcScopeId = DvcScopeId,
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventVendor = "CrowdStrike",
        EventProduct = "Falcon",
        EventSchema = "Authentication",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventSeverity = "Informational",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserEntityKey = "",
        ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        TargetUserEntityKey = "",
        TargetUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
        SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
        TargetSystemEntityKey = "",
        ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
        TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        AdditionalFields = SourceFields
    | extend Dst = Dvc, User = TargetUsername, IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventCount,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventSeverity,
        EventType, EventSubType, EventResult, EventResultDetails,
        EventOriginalType, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalResultDetails,
        Dvc, DvcId, DvcIdType, DvcIpAddr, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType,
        DvcFQDN, DvcOs, DvcScopeId, DvcEntityKey,
        Src, SrcIpAddr, SrcHostname, SrcDomain, SrcDomainType, SrcFQDN,
        TargetHostname, TargetDomain, TargetDomainType, TargetFQDN,
        TargetDvcId, TargetDvcIdType, TargetIpAddr, TargetDvcOs, TargetDvcScopeId,
        TargetUsername, TargetUsernameType, TargetUserId, TargetUserIdType,
        TargetUserSid, TargetUserUid, TargetUserUpn, TargetUserScope,
        TargetUserType, TargetOriginalUserType, TargetSessionId, LogonProtocol,
        Dst, User, IpAddr, ActorUserEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds,
        TargetUserEntityKey, TargetUserAdditionalIds, SrcSystemEntityKey,
        TargetSystemEntityKey, ActingApplicationEntityKey, TargetApplicationEntityKey,
        AdditionalEntities, AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
